headline: Pasadena Hillside Estate Transformation
articleBody:
1.2-acre sloped property converted from unusable terrain into multi-level entertaining oasis featuring infinity pool, outdoor kitchen, and native landscape. Engineering addressed 35° slopes with tiered retaining walls.

Outcome: Completed under budget in 14 weeks. Hosts 50+ guests weekly. Property value increased 18%. Zero maintenance issues after 2 years.
